articles.title: More than 23,500 Simba customers affected in data breach involving IC numbers, birth dates
articles.content: SINGAPORE: Telecommunications company Simba has suffered a data breach affecting 23,549 customers, involving names, identity card numbers and dates of birth. No credit card or bank account information is "at risk", the company said
